mapper.sql: ci.id, ci.user_id, ci.book_id, b.title AS book_title, b.author, b.publisher, b.isbn, b.price, b.stock, b.status, ci.quantity, ci.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cart_item ci LEFT JOIN book b ON ci.book_id = b.id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ci.created_at DESC, ci.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (user_id, book_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{quantity})
